E159_context.source: docs/reports/data/2026-11-04-q140q-gemm-g4-stride/checks-g4.json ii_E159_zeros_spread (README check (ii)): E159's three fp32 zeros holds, three shapes

start_dependence.measured: dW_meas = meas.w(S2-int8-zeros-cold) - meas.w(S2-int8-zeros-warm55), each score_e168.build's window mean (the in-kernel samples of the last 40 s)
start_dependence.predicted: dW_G4 = pred.G4.w(cold) - pred.G4.w(warm55), each score_e168.score's G4 from that hold's own measured start (the primary path); dW_G3 the same with G3 as frozen; dW_E136 the same with E136's law; the frozen nominal differences beside

reading.rule: with h = dW_G4 / 2 (half G4's mechanical difference): 'G4's start dependence SUPPORTED' if dW_meas >= +h; 'NO START DEPENDENCE (E159's reading)' if -h < dW_meas < +h; 'OPPOSITE SIGN: the window board falls with the start, the direction of a leakage law in the absolute die' if dW_meas <= -h. If dW_G4 <= 0.2 W the test has no power and is labelled so, with no reading
reported_beside: the window die difference, measured against G4's
